statement.text: Let $\sigma=(\sigma_{ij})$, $1\leqslant i\ne j\leqslant n$, be an irreducible elementary net (carpet) of order $n\geqslant 3$ over a field $K$ (see 19.48). The net $\sigma$ is said to be closed if the elementary net subgroup $E(\sigma)$ does not contain new elementary transvections. The net $\sigma$ is said to be completable if its diagonal can be supplemented with subgroups to a complete net. Do there exist irreducible closed elementary nets of order $n\geqslant 3$ over a field of odd characteristic that are not completable?
